summary: Blocker found immediately: the new backend endpoint GET /api/dashboard/executive does NOT exist in the codebase. grep for 'executive' across /app/backend/*.py returns zero matches (only the frontend call in Dashboard.jsx line 56). Live API confirms 404 for period=month with a valid admin bearer token. As a result the rewritten Dashboard renders but with all zeros and a CRA 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay (AxiosError 404) blocking the whole page. No deeper frontend verification (period tabs data switching, ranking, recent sales -> EditSaleSheet, alert navigation) was possible because there is no data. Legacy /api/dashboard/stats still returns 200 (regression OK). Created pytest regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_dashboard_executive_iter11.py (5 failed / 1 passed - all failures are the missing endpoint).

critical.issue: Endpoint not implemented at all - returns 404 for period=month|prev|year (with and without auth). The claimed edit to server.py above /api/dashboard/stats was never applied (no 'executive' string anywhere in /app/backend).

ui_bugs.issue: CRA red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay covers the page because load() has no try/catch and the axios 404 rejection is unhandled. Add loading/error state handling per guidelines.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/dashboard/executive?period=month returns 404 -> hero CA 0 EUR / objectif hardcoded fallback 100 000 EUR / 0% , all KPI cards 0, alerts show 'Tout est a jour' (false positive), ranking + recent sales empty. Note: /api/dashboard/stats reports 8 sales, CA 41 470 EUR, 10 clients, 4 to_schedule, 4 in_progress - so data exists.

action_items: Implement GET /api/dashboard/executive?period=month|prev|year in /app/backend/server.py (mounted on api_router, above /api/dashboard/stats) returning period, range{start,end}, ca{total,objectif,progress,delta_pct}, sales{count,delta_pct}, clients_count, projects{to_schedule,in_progress,completed}, ranking[] sorted desc by ca with {commercial,ca,count,objectif,progress}, commissions{total,to_validate_count,to_validate_amount}, overtime{pending_hours,pending_count}, alerts[{key,label,count,href}], recent_sales[] (6 max, no _id), protected by require_sales_access (commercial 200 / technicien 403).
Wrap Dashboard load() in try/catch with an error state so a failed API does not blow up the page with the runtime-error overlay.
Do not show 'Tout est a jour' in the alerts card when the fetch failed - distinguish empty vs error.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend calls an endpoint that does not exist - backend/frontend were not committed together; verify with a curl before handing off.
Dashboard.jsx hardcodes an objectif fallback of 100000 in the client (line 59); objectif must come from backend/settings only.
No loading skeleton: data null renders zeros indistinguishable from a genuine 0 CA.
test_credentials: admin admin@example.invalid / CHANGE_ME_TEST_PASSWORD (login works, token 235 chars)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_dashboard_executive_iter11.py covers all executive shape/period/auth/CA-consistency assertions plus legacy stats. Re-run `python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_executive_iter11.py -v` from /app/backend once the endpoint exists, then do the frontend flow (period tabs, alert-<key> navigation to /chantiers,/heures-sup,/commissions, commissions & overtime card navigation, ranking-row-<i> progress bars, recent-sale-<id> opening EditSaleSheet). Role-based checks (commercial 200 / technicien 403) were NOT run - no non-admin credentials available; main agent should provide or seed them.
rca_of_the_issue: The /api/dashboard/executive route was never added to /app/backend/server.py (grep 'executive' -> 0 matches in backend; server.py has only /dashboard/stats at line 492). FastAPI therefore returns 404, axios rejects, and Dashboard.jsx's unguarded load() propagates the rejection to the CRA error overlay.
